content:
As Apple prepares to roll out macOS 27 Golden Gate later this year, the company continues its beta testing efforts and has now released the fifth beta to developers. Here is a preview of what this update contains.

Apple Releases macOS 27 Beta 5

Three weeks ago, Apple released macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 4, followed a few days later by the corresponding public beta version.

Apple is now rolling out macOS Golden Gate beta 5, continuing to fix bugs and improve performance in preparation for its official release this year.

macOS 27 Golden Gate introduces an all-new Siri application along with a redesigned Siri AI. The system also features an AI-powered new version of the "Shortcuts" app, allowing users to create shortcuts using natural language commands, as well as a prompt-based Safari extension authoring tool.

In addition, macOS 27 Golden Gate adds new Golden Gate-style wallpapers and screensavers, while restoring the corner radius of windows and applications to a fixed size. This change reverses the approach taken in macOS 26, where the system would adjust the corner radius based on the contents of each window or application's menu bar.

The build number for macOS 27 Golden Gate beta 5 is 26A5406e. We are currently diving deep into this new beta and will share more findings with you later.

How to Install the macOS 27 Golden Gate Beta

Here is how to install macOS 27 Golden Gate developer beta 5:

  • Back Up Your Mac
  • Open System Settings
  • Go to General → Software Update
  • Click the "i" icon next to "Beta Updates"
  • Select "macOS Developer Golden Gate Beta" from the drop-down menu in the upper right corner
  • Click "Done"

Have you discovered any new features in this macOS 27 Golden Gate beta? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
